status: selection policy only; no solver run or paid model calls
motivation: Existing three authored zvec cases cover causal debugging. Add one behavior/architecture tracing case, borrowing the task taxonomy and paired-QA mechanism from the pinned reference audit. This is workload coverage development, not selection of a known favorable model outcome.

candidate_pool.snapshot_policy: Save raw first 100 results, then order those by closed_at descending and issue number descending as tie breaker. This is a bounded purposive pool, not an exhaustive/random sample.

eligibility: Closed issue supplies an actionable user-facing behavior, configuration, architecture or API-contract question; infer neither missing observations nor timings.
Answer is demonstrable from one exact immutable zvec source revision, including related tests/docs where present.
Answer genuinely requires tracing at least two distinct implementation components or layers; a lone definition/literal lookup is ineligible.
A scenario-only question can be authored without exposing resolution, culprit symbols or a requested patch.
Question can be scored through a small set of independent source-grounded claims without requiring unperformed runtime outcomes.
selection: Inspect in the declared order; record exclusion reasons; select the first eligible case after source verification, before any solver answer or retrieval trial. Do not skip based on expected zg advantage.
source_policy: For behavior/architecture QA, use the immutable repository default-branch head observed at selection, or a documented issue-linked commit if required for the stated version. Unlike prior bug tasks this may include implemented fixes; disclose this and ask about implemented behavior, not rediscovery of a hidden patch. Export no git/history/issues/gold.
primary_endpoint: source-grounded final-answer quality, with factual points and core citation sufficiency separately reported
frozen_previous_rules: Unchanged; prior joint efficiency signals retain their failed/mixed verdicts.
before_execution: frozen source export and leak validation
one-case paired execution plan frozen separately
